about.name: Coach Mike Sparks
about.bio:
Hi, I’m Mike! I’m an experienced football coach with a background in competitive and travel-level play, dedicated to helping young athletes grow both on and off the field.

My training focuses on building strong fundamentals, improving fitness, and developing game awareness, while also emphasizing discipline, confidence, and a strong work ethic. I create a structured but supportive environment where players are challenged, encouraged, and motivated to reach their full potential.

Whether your child is just starting out or looking to take their game to the next level, I tailor each session to fit their goals and skill level.

Session Structure:
I recommend 2-hour sessions for the best results:
• Hour 1: Strength, conditioning, and endurance
• Hour 2: Technical skills, agility, and game-focused training

($50 per hour or $100 for a full 2-hour session.)

My goal is simple: help your child improve in every aspect, and develop a lasting love for the game.
